name: io.github.yui666a/mcp-server-for-mattermost
title: Mattermost
description: Read and post to Mattermost as each user via per-user OAuth. Self-hosted, works with Team Edition.

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public origin of this server behind the reverse proxy, without a trailing slash

environmentVariables.name: MM_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of the Mattermost OAuth app

environmentVariables.name: MM_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the Mattermost OAuth app

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_ENC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base64 of a 32-byte key that encrypts stored tokens (openssl rand -base64 32)

environmentVariables.name: MM_URL
environmentVariables.description: Mattermost URL the server calls; defaults to PUBLIC_URL

environmentVariables.name: LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: Language of tool descriptions and output

environmentVariables.name: TIME_ZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone for reading and writing times
